name: io.github.sepehr071/iranseda-mcp
title: Iranseda Radio Archive
description: Read-only Iranseda (IRIB audio): radio channels, live streams, schedules, audiobooks, music, Quran.

environmentVariables.name: IRANSEDA_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Iranseda requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
